data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each Fisher02–25 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching from 10 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). This risks future income, not guaranteed optimal. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Please state your exact intended catch and any conditions; you may choose 18 even if others choose 10.
